```{python}
#| label: fig-bench-spatial
#| fig-cap: "Spatial query throughput by channel. Channel 1: CoordSet axis filters on Dense+CoordPath (58-329 Melem/s via bitwise AND). Channel 2: CoordCube region generation on Tree+CoordCube (96-353 Melem/s path gen, 31 Melem/s KV lookup). The two channels are complementary — CoordSet for set membership, CoordCube for spatial region enumeration."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

ch1_ops = ['Axis\nmedial=10', 'Range\ninit 3-7', 'Compound\ninit=3,med=5']
ch2_ops = ['Prox r=1\n9 paths', 'Prox r=5\n121 paths', 'BBox 10K\n10K paths']

ch1_cs = [ 58.0, 158.0, 329.0]   # CoordSet AND (Dense+Path)
ch1_hm = [ 24.5,  77.3,   2.4]
ratios  = ['2.4x', '2.0x', '137x']

ch2_gen = [ 96.4, 353.0, 699.0]   # CoordCube path gen (pure)
ch2_kv  = [ 31.4,  39.5,   0.0]   # CoordCube KV lookup (dense, r=1/r=2; bbox N/A)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
x = range(len(ch1_ops) + len(ch2_ops))
w = 0.22

# Channel 1: CoordSet AND (Dense+Path) vs HashMap
for i in range(3):
    ax.bar(x[i] - w, ch1_cs[i], w, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='///')
    ax.bar(x[i], ch1_hm[i], w, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8)

# Channel 2: CoordCube Gen (tree) + KV lookup (tree)
off = 3
for i in range(3):
    ax.bar(x[off+i] - w, ch2_gen[i], w, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='...')
    if ch2_kv[i] > 0:
        ax.bar(x[off+i], ch2_kv[i], w, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='ooo')

all_labels = ch1_ops + ch2_ops
ax.set_xticks(list(x))
ax.set_xticklabels(all_labels, fontsize=7)
ax.set_ylabel('Throughput (Melem/s)')
ax.set_yscale('log')
ax.set_ylim(1, 2000)

# Legend
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
ax.legend(handles=[
    Patch(facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', hatch='///', label='Dense+CoordPath (CoordSet)'),
    Patch(facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', label='HashMap'),
    Patch(facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', hatch='...', label='Tree+CoordCube (path gen)'),
    Patch(facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', hatch='ooo', label='Tree+CoordCube (KV lookup)'),
], fontsize=6.5, loc='upper left')

for i, (cs, hm, ratio) in enumerate(zip(ch1_cs, ch1_hm, ratios)):
    ax.annotate(ratio, xy=(i, (cs * hm) ** 0.5), fontsize=8, fontweight='bold',
                ha='center', va='center',
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.12', facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.85))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
